name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ウマ娘 プリティーダービー サイレンススズカ
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Uma Musume Pretty Derby Silence Suzuka

series.ja: ウマ娘 プリティーダービー

brands.ja: Figure-rise Standard[フィギュアライズ スタンダード]

categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 『ウマ娘 プリティーダービー 』よりサイレンススズカがFigure-rise Standardシリーズで商品化‼
description.en: Silence Suzuka from “Uma Musume Pretty Derby” is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!

description.ja: • スカートは前後の分割で大きく可動域を確保することができる。広がる動きにも対応し、シルエットを崩さずに前傾姿勢で走る姿が決まる。
description.en: • The skirt can be divided into front and back sections to provide a wide range of motion. It also supports widening movements, allowing you to run with a forward leaning posture without compromising your silhouette.

description.ja: • 表情の異なる3種の顔パーツが付属。笑顔の瞳は「タンポ印刷」で再現。他2種は水転写式デカールを採用。
description.en: • Comes with 3 types of face parts with different expressions. The smiling eyes are reproduced with "tampo printing". The other two types use water transfer decals.

description.ja: • 1パーツ単位で構造を追求することにより、組み立てるだけでカラフルな“勝負服”ができあがる。
description.en: • By pursuing the structure of each part, colorful "competition clothes" can be created using just assembly.

description.ja: • 頭部は効果的にパーツを分割。表情が付けられる耳や髪、カチューシャやアクセサリーの色分けも細かく表現。
description.en: • The head is effectively divided into parts. The ears, hair, headband, and accessories that can be used to express expressions are also detailed in color.

description.ja: • 上体を反らすことで躍動感のある走りを再現。しっぽもフレキシブルに可動。
description.en: • Reproduce dynamic running by arching the upper body. The tail can also be moved flexibly.

description.ja: • 靴底の蹄鉄はシールで再現。靴の前後を分割することで、地面を蹴る姿もしなやかに表現。
description.en: • The horseshoes on the soles are reproduced with Seal. By splitting the front and back of the shoe, it gives a supple look when kicking the ground.

description.ja: • 表情付きハンドパーツが左右4種類付属。
description.en: • 4 types of left and right hand parts with expressions are included.

description.ja: • クリア成形の台座（アクションベース6）が付属。支柱を背中に接続し、走る姿でボディを保持することができる。
description.en: • Comes with a clear molded base (Action Base 6). By connecting the pillar to the back, you can hold the body while running.

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(タンポ印刷)×1種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (tampo printing) x 1 type

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(水転写式デカール)×2種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (water transfer decal) x 2 types
